title: Catch!
lines: Dan tosses a stick for his pup.
The pup runs to catch it.
The stick lands in a wet ditch.
The pup will not go in the ditch.
Dan hops in and catches the stick.
His pants have a patch of mud.
He pitches the stick up the hill.
This time the pup catches it. Dan claps.

questions.ask: Where did the stick land the first time?
questions.listenFor: In a wet ditch. Stated in the story - have them reread that line rather than telling them.

questions.ask: Why does Dan have a patch of mud on his pants?
questions.listenFor: He hopped into the ditch to get the stick himself. Cause and effect - if they say "mud," ask "how did he get in the mud?"

questions.ask: Do you think the pup was scared of the ditch? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is correct. You want a reason from the text - "it would not go in" is exactly the kind of evidence you are after.
